description: Emoji Picker and Image Upload in DM Message Compose. Make the emoji button open an emoji picker (using Mastodon's existing emoji-mart Picker component) and the attachment button open a file picker for images, upload via /api/v2/media, show preview, and send media_ids with messages.
steps: 1. Emoji integration in app/javascript/mastodon/features/dm/components/message_compose.tsx: Import the Picker component from 'mastodon/features/emoji/emoji_picker'. Add state for emoji picker visibility (showEmojiPicker). The emoji button toggles showEmojiPicker. When visible, render the Picker positioned above/below the button. On emoji select (onClick callback receives emoji object with .native property), insert emoji.native at cursor position in the textarea, then close picker. Handle click-outside to close.

2. Image upload - Add state to message_compose.tsx: mediaFiles (array of {id: string, preview_url: string, file: File} objects), uploading (boolean), uploadProgress (number). Add a hidden file input with accept='image/*' and multiple attribute (max 4). The attachment button clicks the hidden file input.

3. Image upload - upload handler: When files are selected, for each file create a FormData with 'file' appended, POST to /api/v2/media using the api() client (import from 'mastodon/api'). Track progress. On success (status 200), add the returned media attachment to mediaFiles state. On 202, poll /api/v1/media/:id until ready. Limit total to 4 images.

4. Image preview UI: Above the textarea/compose area, if mediaFiles has items, show a preview row with thumbnails. Each thumbnail has a remove button (X) that removes it from the array. Show upload progress indicator while uploading.

5. Send with media: Modify handleSubmit to include media_ids in the sendMessage dispatch: dispatch(sendMessage(roomId, { content: trimmed, media_ids: mediaFiles.map(m => m.id) })). Allow sending with only media (no text required if media attached). Clear mediaFiles after send.

6. Translations - en.json: 'dm.compose.attach_image' = 'Attach image', 'dm.compose.uploading' = 'Uploading...', 'dm.compose.remove_image' = 'Remove image', 'dm.compose.max_images' = 'Maximum 4 images'. ko.json: '이미지 첨부', '업로드 중...', '이미지 제거', '최대 4개 이미지'.

7. Styles - app/javascript/styles/mastodon/dm.scss: Add styles for .dm-message-compose__emoji-picker (positioned absolutely above the compose area), .dm-message-compose__media-preview (flex row of thumbnails above textarea), .dm-message-compose__media-item (thumbnail container with remove button), .dm-message-compose__upload-progress (progress bar).
acceptance_criteria: Emoji button opens a picker with search and categories
Selecting an emoji inserts it at cursor position in the textarea
Clicking outside the emoji picker closes it
Attachment button opens file picker filtered to images only
Upload progress is shown during upload
Uploaded images show as thumbnail previews above the compose area
Remove button on thumbnails removes that attachment
Sending a message includes media_ids when attachments are present
After sending, media previews are cleared
A message can be sent with only media (empty text)
verification: Verify en.json and ko.json have all new translations
Code review: verify emoji picker uses the existing Picker from features/emoji/emoji_picker.tsx
Code review: verify upload uses api().post('/api/v2/media', formData) pattern from actions/compose.js
findings: TypeScript compiles without errors. Emoji picker uses existing Picker component from features/emoji/emoji_picker.tsx with loadCustomEmojiData for lazy loading custom emojis. Image upload uses api().post('/api/v2/media', formData) pattern matching compose.js. sendMessage already supports media_ids param. Added position:relative to .dm-message-compose and restructured layout with __input-row wrapper to accommodate media preview and emoji picker positioning.
